recipes.name: Turkey & Caviar inspired by Star Trek: The Next Generation
ingredients: 1 whole chicken (about 3 1/2 4 lbs), patted completely dry
1 cup cold unsalted Danish Creamery European Style Butter, cubed
freshly ground white pepper, to taste
2 1/2 tbsp high quality white sturgeon caviar, optional
instructions: For the Chicken
Pat chicken bone-dry with paper towels. This is necessary for safe-frying. - 1 whole chicken (about 3 1/2 4 lbs) patted completely dry
Season generously with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper inside and out. - kosher salt - freshly ground black pepper - 1 whole chicken (about 3 1/2 4 lbs) patted completely dry
Let rest uncovered in the fridge for 30-60 minutes to dry out further while you heat your oil. - For the Chicken

In a Dutch Oven or deep fryer, heat enough neutral oil to submerge the chicken to 325°F (163°C). Proceed with caution. Frying a whole bird indoors is dangerous and should not be attempted without proper space, tools, and fire safety gear. - neutral oil for frying
Using a sturdy hook or tongs, very carefully lower the chicken into the hot oil. - 1 whole chicken (about 3 1/2 4 lbs) patted completely dry
Fry for 10-12 minutes, then check the internal temperature. It should be 150°F in the breast and 165°F in the thigh. - For the Chicken
If it’s not cooked through, transfer the whole chicken to a preheated 375°F (190°C) oven and roast until done. About 20-30 minutes. - For the Chicken
Rest for 10 minutes before carving. - For the Chicken
For the Beurre Blanc
In a small saucepan, combine minced shallot, white wine, and vinegar. - ½ small shallot finely minced - ½ cup dry white wine - 1 tbsp white wine vinegar
Bring to a brisk simmer and reduce until about 2 tbsp of liquid remain.
Lower heat to the bare minimum.
Whisk in cold butter cubes one at a time. Allow each cube to fully emulsify before adding the next. - 1 cup cold unsalted Danish Creamery European Style Butter cubed

If the sauce starts to separate or look oily, remove from the heat and whisk. Or add a splash of water to pull it back together. The final sauce should be glossy, velvety, and thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. - 1 tbsp water as needed - For the Beurre Blanc
Once the Beurre Blanc is silky smooth and just warm, but not hot, gently fold in the caviar. - 2 ½ tbsp high quality white sturgeon caviar optional - For the Beurre Blanc
Then, pass the sauce through a fine mesh sieve.
For the Serving
Carve the chicken, keeping the skin intact, spoon the Caviar Beurre Blanc generously over the slices. - For the Chicken - For the Beurre Blanc
Garnish with parsley and flaky finishing salt, and serve immediately. - chopped parsley for garnish - flaky finishing salt for garnish
